name: Entrance Test Allocated

next_step_note: Your application process is complete. Please proceed to the next stage as instructed.

next_step_note: You have been selected as per the merit list. Please proceed to the next stage of the process.

next_step_note: You have accepted the offer. Please proceed to the next stage as instructed.

next_step_note: Your offer letter has been issued. Please review it and respond within the given timeframe.

next_step_note: The offer validity period has passed without a response. Please check the communication sent to you for further details.

next_step_note: Your interview has been scheduled. Please check the details and be prepared to attend on the given date and time.

next_step_note: You did not meet the requirements at the interview stage. Please check the communication sent to you for further details.

next_step_note: The merit list has been published. Please check your position and status.

next_step_note: Your enrollment is complete. Please wait for further communication regarding onboarding.

name: Withdrawn
next_step_note: Your enrollment has been withdrawn. Please check the communication sent to you for further details.

name: Entrance Test Scheduled
next_step_note: Your entrance test has been scheduled. Please check the details and be prepared to appear on the given date and time.

name: Seat Selected
next_step_note: A seat has been allocated to you. Please proceed to the next stage as instructed.

name: Seat Rejected
next_step_note: You were not allocated a seat. Please check the communication sent to you for further details.

name: Submitted
next_step_note: Your application is received and under review. Please pay the application fee, if pending, to proceed further.

name: Entrance Test Rejected
next_step_note: You did not meet the requirements at the entrance test stage. Please check the communication sent to you for further details.

name: Interview Completed
next_step_note: You have completed the interview process. Please wait for further updates on the next stage.
